exposure: History of posterior deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE)
previously excised posterior deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE)
cohort: 62 women with previous surgical excision of posterior DIE and 186 matched controls, all of whom had singleton pregnancies
finding: Women with a history of DIE, despite previous surgical excision, have an increased risk of placenta previa, gestational hypertension, and intrauterine growth restriction during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Previous surgery for DIE does not seem to predispose to failed vaginal delivery.
